exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2
Total bilirubin ≤1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal
AST ≤ 3 x institutional upper limit of normal
ALT ≤ 3 x institutional upper limit of normal
Creatinine clearance ≥ 40 mL/min for participants with creatinine levels above institutional normal
women and men of child-bearing potential must agree to use adequate contraception
patients who have a known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
Myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to enrollment or New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class III or IV heart failure
exclusions.threshold: MI within 6 months; NYHA class III or IV

exclusions.source_text: Individuals with a history of a different malignancy are ineligible except for the following circumstances.
Female patients who are pregnant (positive β-HCG) or breastfeeding
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal
Creatinine clearance ≥ 40 mL/min for participants with creatinine levels above institutional normal
